timing.export_internal_scope: Local reads, audit, prefix replay, exact baseline and selected cascade stages; excludes model loading/report writing; not live overhead
timing.repeat_scope: Second local reads, audit, complete prefix replay and DCPG construction; warm shared encoder; no model construction or report writing
timing.whole_validation_scope: Input hashing, local model construction, one report export, one repeat per run, comparison and final integrity checks; no live agent timing

notes: All matching uses recorded request prefixes and the local pinned MiniLM model.
The first export and subsequent replay use the same encoder instance; cache warmth affects timing.
Graph serialization and replay equality do not establish provenance accuracy or maliciousness.
Each recorded run starts an independent graph; this batch does not establish cross-session storage continuity.
No accuracy estimate, causal probe, canary insertion, action interception, or parameter update is performed.

counts.path_count_scope: paths retained per proposal; repeated observations are counted separately
counts.binding_count_scope: latest binding per record in each independent run graph
